name: Shard of True Ice
desc: Increases your damage against slowed enemies by % and increases the duration of Heartchill by sec.

name: Siphon Mana
desc: Drain its value mana every sec from your Raised minions within yds in exchange for Runic Power.

name: Skeletal Warrior Mastery
desc: Command: Skeletal Warriors cooldown is reduced by sec and now applies Overwhelmed.

name: Sludge Belcher
desc: Reduces the cost of Command spells.

name: Soulfreeze
desc: Launch a chain of frost at an enemy, dealing its value Frost Damage every sec. Each tick generates Runic Power.

name: Sower of Sickness
desc: Increases the effectiveness of Malady spells by %.

name: Spellbound Champion
desc: Summon a Spellbound Champion that deflects spells cast on you, redirecting them to itself. Shares a 2min cooldown with other Champion spells.

name: Study of Death
desc: When you cast Unholy Frenzy you now summon 3 Greater Zombies to aid you in combat. Damage dealt by your Undead minions now reduces the cooldown of Unholy Frenzy by sec.

name: Summoning Adept
desc: Increases Life Force.

name: Summoning Expert
desc: Level 30 Passive Increases your maximum Life Force by and your Undead minion's Stamina by %.

name: Summoning Mastery
desc: Teaches you how to raise Flesh Golems and Gurgling Horrors.

name: Summoning Prodigy
desc: Increases the duration of Skeletal Archers by sec.

name: Summoning Ritual
desc: Summon a ritual circle at your location. While active, you may cast Ritual Return to return to it.

name: Summoning Stone
desc: Reduces the cast time of Animate and Raise spells by %.

name: Symphony of Bones
desc: Increases damage done by Undead Minions by %.

name: Tears of Lordaeron
desc: Direct critical strikes now generates Runic Power.

name: Transfer Life
desc: Channel life into your Raised minions within yds, healing them for % of their maximum health plus its value every sec.

name: Tundra Warriors
desc: Level 10 Passive Casting any spell now has a % chance to grant you Tundra Warriors.

name: Undead: Assault
desc: Your undead minions assume an aggresive behaviour, increasing movement speed by %. Your critical strike chance against Humanoids is increased by %. Only 1 Undead Stance can be active at a time.

name: Undead: Pacify
desc: Your undead minions assume a passive behavior and will not attack enemies or cast spells. Reduces your damage taken by %. Only 1 Undead Stance can be active at a time.

name: Undead: Protect
desc: Your undead minions assume a defensive behavior, increasing threat and Armor. Reduces your threat generated by %. Only 1 Undead Stance can be active at a time.

name: Underking
desc: Casting Command spells now grants you a stack of Underking. At 10 stacks, the cooldown of or Animate: Plaguefather is reduced by sec at random.

name: Unholy Command: Initiate, Colossus. Grave Mage
Unholy Erosion
desc: Level 50 Passive Increases your spell penetration by its value, scaling with your level.

name: Unholy Frenzy
desc: Enrage your Undead minions, increasing their haste by % and movement speed by %.

name: Unrelenting
desc: Reduces the channel time of your Crypt Swarm|R by %.

name: Unrelenting Army
desc: Damage dealt by Harvest Plague now has a % chance to summon a Lesser Zombie to aid you in combat.

name: Unrelenting Swarm
desc: Reduces the Runic Power drained by each Crypt Scarabs tick.

name: Vampiric Aura
desc: While you are below 50% health, your Undead minions now heal you for % of their damage dealt.

name: Virulency
desc: Refreshes all Necromancer diseases on the target enemy.

name: Winds of Northrend
desc: Increases the amount slowed by Lichfrost by -15%.

name: Withering
desc: Level 40 Passive Allows Crypt Plague to stack additional times.

name: Wormfood
desc: Expunge now consumes Parasite from enemies to deal % increased damage per stack and harvests a Handful of Worms.

name: Wormskin
desc: Whenever you or a permanent pet you control takes non-periodic damage, you have a chance to afflict the attacker with your Flesh to Worms Disease. Only functions you know the Flesh to Worms spell.

name: Wretched Bile
desc: While your Fetid Shield is active, melee or ranged damage now has a % chance to afflict the attacker with Wretched Bile.
